name: csp-wa-server
description: Baileys-based WhatsApp HTTP server for CSP platform (no Chromium — direct WebSocket protocol)
_why_baileys_6: PINNED to the 6.x line ON PURPOSE. Baileys 7.x is ESM-only, and wa_server.js
is CommonJS (require), so a fresh install on a new CSP failed at startup with
ERR_REQUIRE_ESM and WhatsApp could not run at all. 7.0.0-rc13 was also a
release CANDIDATE — not something to ship to CSP machines. Do not widen this
range to ^7 without first converting wa_server.js to ESM (or dynamic import).
